title: I’m creating an isometric extraction looter
author: FeelingGrape94

comments.author: Lambisexual
comments.body: Environment and blood splatter looks pretty good. Did you use Tripo for the characters/assets?

replies.author: FeelingGrape94
replies.body: No, everything making in blender with MCP Claude.

replies.author: Lambisexual
replies.body: Huh, interesting. Even the characters? I usually get shit result trying to make characters with AI in Blender.

replies.author: FeelingGrape94
replies.body: At first, it looked like shit. It took me a long time to get it to look like this, but it’s still not quite as perfect as I’d like it to be. It’ll probably take a bit more time before I’m actually happy with the result.

replies.author: Lambisexual
replies.body: That's understandable. Looks like you're on the right track at least

comments.author: deReaLizedGames
comments.body: This looks fantastic! I would not have guessed this was AI. Great art style and animations. I think the enemy health bars are way too big though, they're bigger than some of the enemies/kind of cover them lol. You're really close to the combat feeling really weighty - I think if you polish that up just a bit more I think this would genuinely do well. I think increasing the sword swing animation speed a bit and improving enemy hit reactions would go a long way.

replies.author: FeelingGrape94
replies.body: I'm glad you like it, and thanks for the feedback.

comments.author: passyourownbutter
comments.body: Looks great so far. Would play!
